g.text: Composable rendering features (ADR-0028) — recognition per format, everything downstream shared
Shared feature layers — one module per construct, every dialect
before they shipped: the mature parsers (remark-gfm/micromark,
uniorg, unified-latex) already deliver this, so the GFM box became
a delegated recognizer too. Every shared layer to its right survived.
a format's recognizer over its source text (delegated to a mature parser)
the IR core, the shared feature layers, the ANSI back-end
the one sanitize seam for raw HTML
